rate_limited.title: PoLR Stocks is hitting Finnhub's rate limit
rate_limited.description:
Quotes were cut short by Finnhub's rate limit on several consecutive updates, so some tickers may be showing an older price.

You are polling {symbols} tickers every {interval} seconds, which is one API call per ticker per update. Raise the update interval in the integration's Configure dialog, or track fewer tickers.

This notice clears itself once updates complete normally again.
